blocks.en: Enzyme Defense is an educational mini-game designed to illustrate the concept of enzyme specificity and our project’s application in degrading PET plastic via TfCut2. Players control an enzyme with shape-specific active sites, catching matching substrates (representing PET molecules) to degrade them and prevent landfill buildup.
blocks.text: Enzyme Defense is an educational mini-game designed to illustrate the concept of enzyme specificity and our project’s application in degrading PET plastic via TfCut2. Players control an enzyme with shape-specific active sites, catching matching substrates (representing PET molecules) to degrade them and prevent landfill buildup.
blocks.zh: Enzyme Defense 是一款教育小遊戲，用來說明酵素專一性的概念，以及我們的專題如何以 TfCut2 分解 PET 塑膠。玩家操控一個帶有形狀專一活性位的酵素，接住形狀相符的受質（代表 PET 分子）把它們分解，避免掩埋場越堆越高。

blocks.en: Demonstrate enzyme-substrate specificity through the lock-and-key mechanism.
blocks.text: Demonstrate enzyme-substrate specificity through the lock-and-key mechanism.
blocks.zh: 以鎖與鑰匙的機制展示酵素與受質的專一性。

blocks.en: Simulate real-world PET degradation by showing the accumulation of plastic waste if not degraded efficiently.
blocks.text: Simulate real-world PET degradation by showing the accumulation of plastic waste if not degraded efficiently.
blocks.zh: 呈現真實世界的 PET 分解：分解得不夠快，塑膠廢棄物就會一直累積。

blocks.en: Engage players interactively to understand how engineered enzymes like TfCut2 work in breaking down PET for recycling.
blocks.text: Engage players interactively to understand how engineered enzymes like TfCut2 work in breaking down PET for recycling.
blocks.zh: 讓玩家在互動中理解 TfCut2 這類工程改造酵素如何分解 PET 以供回收。

blocks.en: Controls: Use ← and → arrow keys to move.
blocks.text: Controls: Use ← and → arrow keys to move.
blocks.zh: 操作：以 ← 和 → 方向鍵移動。

blocks.en: Objective: Catch only matching substrates to degrade them.
blocks.text: Objective: Catch only matching substrates to degrade them.
blocks.zh: 目標：只接住形狀相符的受質，把它們分解掉。

blocks.en: Challenge: Missing substrates increases landfill buildup; catching the wrong shape stuns the enzyme temporarily.
blocks.text: Challenge: Missing substrates increases landfill buildup; catching the wrong shape stuns the enzyme temporarily.
blocks.zh: 挑戰：漏掉受質會讓掩埋場堆得更高；接到錯誤的形狀會讓酵素暫時失去作用。

blocks.en: End Condition: The game ends after 3 levels (20 seconds each).
blocks.text: End Condition: The game ends after 3 levels (20 seconds each).
blocks.zh: 結束條件：遊戲在 3 關之後結束（每關 20 秒）。

blocks.zh: 以有趣的方式呈現酵素分解的運作，Enzyme-Substrate Match Defense 讓一般大眾認識：

blocks.en: The importance of enzyme engineering in environmental biotechnology
blocks.text: The importance of enzyme engineering in environmental biotechnology
blocks.zh: 酵素工程在環境生物技術中的重要性

blocks.en: The urgency of PET pollution and landfill overflow
blocks.text: The urgency of PET pollution and landfill overflow
blocks.zh: PET 污染與掩埋場爆滿的急迫性

blocks.text: The potential of synthetic biology in creating circular solutions for plastic waste
